title: command pallet - dock - does not load correctly

judgment.rationale: The recovery changes both build and Dock configuration, so it does not prove a restart fix or isolate a version regression. Compare the archived old Dock configuration with defaults on the same verified executable version before choosing a content, settings or render fix.
evidence: On the reported 0.102 build, reboot leaves blank reserved top space; module toggles, restarts and process termination do not repair it.
The author's actual winget reinstall output says 0.101.2362.0, despite a 0.102 What's New page.
Most settings survived, but Dock was disabled and its customized content/settings were gone. Enabling the default Dock made it visible.
